from vpython import *

def sierpinski_triangle(v0, v1, v2, depth):
    if depth == 0:
        triangle(vs=[vertex(pos=v0), vertex(pos=v1), vertex(pos=v2)])
        return

    mid1 = (v0 + v1) / 2
    mid2 = (v1 + v2) / 2
    mid3 = (v0 + v2) / 2
    rate(10)
    sierpinski_triangle(v0, mid1, mid3, depth-1)
    sierpinski_triangle(mid1, v1, mid2, depth-1)
    sierpinski_triangle(mid3, mid2, v2, depth-1)

v0 = vec(0, -1, 0)
v1 = vec(-1, 1, 0)
v2 = vec(1, 1, 0)

sierpinski_triangle(v0, v1, v2, depth=3)
